ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read “Distribution Map of Eroded Coasts along China’s Southeastern Coast.” <image1> The east coast of Taiwan Island is more severely eroded by seawater than the west coast. What is the main reason?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, Taiwan Island is located on the right side; the west coast faces the Fujian coast across the relatively narrow Taiwan Strait, while the east coast directly faces a more open sea area. The legend shows that eroded coasts are distributed along some coastal sections of the southeastern coast and near Taiwan Island. Then reason: The strength of coastal erosion is mainly related to the beating and scouring action of sea waves. The east coast of Taiwan Island faces the open ocean and is more directly affected by monsoons, typhoons, etc., so the action of wind and waves is stronger; the west coast is on the Taiwan Strait side, where the sea area is relatively narrow and wind and waves are relatively weaker. Therefore, the main reason why the east coast of Taiwan Island is more severely eroded by seawater than the west coast is strong wind and waves.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出台湾岛的位置及其两侧海域：台湾岛东岸直接面向广阔海洋，西岸面向较狭窄的台湾海峡；图例显示侵蚀海岸集中在东南沿海部分岸段。再结合题干要求比较“台湾岛东岸受海水侵蚀较西岸严重”的原因。运用海岸侵蚀原理：迎向开阔海域、受季风和台风影响更直接的海岸，风浪作用更强，海浪冲刷、拍击能力更大，因此侵蚀更严重。由此归纳答案为：东岸风浪大。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中台湾岛位于右侧，西岸隔着较狭窄的台湾海峡与福建沿海相望，东岸则直接面向更开阔的海域。图例显示侵蚀海岸分布在东南沿海及台湾岛附近的一些岸段。再推理：海岸侵蚀强弱主要与海浪拍击、冲刷作用有关。台湾岛东岸面向开阔海洋，受季风、台风等影响更直接，风浪作用更强；西岸位于台湾海峡一侧，海域较窄，风浪相对较弱。因此台湾岛东岸受海水侵蚀较西岸严重的主要原因是风浪大。
method.model_answer: 东岸风浪大，海浪冲刷作用强。
method.answer_match_reason: 预测答案指出台湾东岸风浪大、海浪冲刷作用强，与标准答案“风浪大”含义一致，并且补充说明了侵蚀更强的作用机制。
